per_claim_judgments.claim: Fixed H2a provides useful retrieval increments on RGBNT201, MSVR310 and RGBNT100 under +0.5 mAP with Rank-1 nondecline.
what_results_support: Small observed positive changes on two datasets and a negative change on RGBNT100.
Completed fixed-implementation negative decision:0/3 primary advances.
what_results_dont_support: Significance, equivalence, a population null effect or failure of all correspondence methods.
per_claim_judgments.reasoning: Primary mAP changes +0.01155769158454234,+0.004553087525593469,-0.563055354664499 all miss+0.5; RGBNT100 also lowers R1. Two tiny observed improvements do not establish partial success of this threshold-defined claim.
missing_evidence: No missing planned endpoint; the intended positive result was not obtained.
per_claim_judgments.suggested_claim_revision: This fixed geometric auxiliary failed the registered useful-retrieval criterion in three complete seed42 development runs despite lower auxiliary loss.
per_claim_judgments.routing: Close this implementation; no post-hoc weight, temperature, view, gain, seed or selection rescue.

per_claim_judgments.claim: Original three endpoints completed real M0, fresh50, first strict evaluation and one CPU report; geometry proxies changed separately from identity retrieval.
per_claim_judgments.qualification: Original bound receipt/text evidence; no independent binary replay or fresh remote observation.
what_results_support: Three real8-step M0s followed by separately fresh50 runs;150 formal epochs/6484 updates excluding24 M0 updates.
Three first strict evaluations and one original complete CPU report.
First-to-last auxiliary means decrease in all three datasets.
what_results_dont_support: Engineering completion or proxy optimization as retrieval success.
Zero new parameters as zero added computation.
per_claim_judgments.reasoning: Original controller/terminal, acceptance records, strict receipts and full histories agree with the completed text audit. Auxiliary optimization and retrieval are separate observations.
missing_evidence: Binary replication was outside this review and the attached local audit; retain that qualification.
per_claim_judgments.suggested_claim_revision: Original receipts support completed execution and changed proxies with local text-only validation limits.

per_claim_judgments.claim: Lower RGBNT100 own-global versus independent-global best proves H2a harmed the shared backbone.
what_results_support: All four own-global metrics equal the sealed global curve at the fused-selected epochs8/38/26.
RGBNT100 global-best selects7 and raw-semantic selects5.
RGBNT100 fused versus own-global at26 is lower, with10 repairs/23 new R1 errors.
what_results_dont_support: Backbone damage inferred from epoch26 versus epoch7.
Identical weights, feature arrays, whole trajectories, all rankings or causal invariance from four equal aggregate metrics.
per_claim_judgments.reasoning: The proposed proof compares differently selected epochs. Same-epoch metric equality removes that evidence for damage without establishing absence of every causal effect. F1 plain-source epoch9 is a different control.
missing_evidence: A matched-epoch controlled causal comparison and sufficient representation/state evidence for any backbone-harm or invariance claim.
per_claim_judgments.suggested_claim_revision: Selected-epoch own-global metrics equal the sealed global history; shared-backbone damage is not diagnosed.
per_claim_judgments.routing: Correct the inference now; no new run is needed to reject this proof.

per_claim_judgments.claim: Very small mapped L1 or decreasing correspondence loss proves reliable identity-relevant region correspondence.
what_results_support: Normalized K-K auxiliary and raw Q-K128-token reading are distinct quantities.
Late RGBNT201 Transformer/Mamba mean reading entropy is near ln128 with mapped L1 around2e-7.
what_results_dont_support: A unique norm/logit-scale cause or collapse of every role/modality/sample.
per_claim_judgments.reasoning: Under the original formula, uniform attention produces equal mapped and restricted visible mass, hence zero mapped L1. The objective supplies geometric overlap, not identity/part labels, and does not guarantee actual Q-K behavior. Some RGBNT100 reading is more selective while retrieval remains negative.
missing_evidence: Semantic/identity validity and causal linkage to net retrieval.
per_claim_judgments.suggested_claim_revision: Geometric/reading diagnostics changed; reliable identity-relevant correspondence remains unproven.

next_experiments_needed.requirement: Preregister identity error targets and a causal reading intervention; record actual Q/K norms/logits, semantic/identity validity and full paired retrieval outcomes.

per_claim_judgments.claim: These results establish stable cross-seed benefit, three necessary novel mechanisms or SOTA.
what_results_support: One fixed seed42 condition per dataset on official benchmarks consumed for development.
A bounded completed negative implementation test.
what_results_dont_support: Cross-seed stability, three necessary novel mechanisms, SOTA, untouched final-test generalization or full-goal completion.
per_claim_judgments.reasoning: One seed gives no training-seed uncertainty; the usefulness criterion failed, and required mechanism/novelty and resource-matched strong-reference evidence is unmet. Three roles or datasets are not three validated novel mechanisms.
missing_evidence: Complete-pipeline paired seeds with fixed selection and appropriate uncertainty.
Distinct mechanism necessity and novelty evidence.
Prospective held-out, protocol/resource-matched strong-reference comparisons with actual cost.
per_claim_judgments.suggested_claim_revision: Only a scoped negative development result is established; broader obligations remain open.

next_experiments_needed.condition: A separately authorized successor first establishes useful benefit
next_experiments_needed.requirement: Preregister full-pipeline paired seeds and necessity controls, then assess a prospective held-out/resource-matched strong-reference protocol with measured cost.

suggested_claim_revision: In three complete seed42 development runs, adding the fixed H2a same-image/same-modality geometric pre-key auxiliary reduced its logged auxiliary loss but failed the preregistered +0.5 mAP and Rank-1 nondecline criterion against raw-semantic on all three datasets. Primary mAP changes were +0.0116,+0.0046,-0.5631 percentage points. Close this fixed implementation under the registered plan; identity-correspondence mechanisms and broader correspondence hypotheses remain unresolved.

next_experiments_needed.action: None for the fixed H2a verdict. Close the implementation, preserve negatives and leave B3 inactive.
Use the existing complete query/identity evidence to specify a falsifiable identity error target. Do not repeat its already completed decomposition or rename closed controls.
Preregister an identity-linked reading intervention with actual Q/K norms/logits, semantic validity and full retrieval tradeoffs.
Collect full-pipeline paired-seed uncertainty/necessity and prospective held-out/resource-matched strong-reference results with measured cost.
